lines.text: There you are, sweet thing! I kept a seat warm for you.

lines: I have been thinking about you a lot. More than usual. Much more.

lines.text: Does that feel strange? It feels a little strange to me too.

choices.text: That is kind of you, Momo.
How long have I been here?

lines.text: Then it is settled. Bring me a flower from the garden.

lines: Any flower. I will know the one you mean.

lines.text: A while. A long, warm, lovely while.

lines: Please do not ask me that again, sweet thing.

lines.text: You asked me that already, sweet thing.

lines: I gave you an answer. I would like to keep it the same answer.

lines.text: Oh, you brought one! It is perfect. Sit, sit.

lines: We will be happy here. We will be happy here for as long as it lasts.

lines.text: For as long as it lasts. Yes. That is a nice way to put it.
You kept the seat warm by coming back. That is the whole trick, you know.
